Rockstar Games

# Announcing Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, Coming November 19
### Featuring 34 New Tracks — Listen to the First Six Singles, Available Today
September 17, 2026 [**Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album**](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/music), the upcoming official soundtrack album created in partnership with Atlantic Records and launching November 19 alongside [**Grand Theft Auto VI**](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI), is available to pre-save on all major music streaming services, with limited-edition vinyl and CD sets also available to pre-order.

Listen to the first six singles today, available across all major music streaming services:

- **Keith Richards** – **Bright Lights, Big City**

Additionally, get exclusive vinyl disc colorways, each featuring unique new art, at Blood Records, Best Buy, Walmart, Amazon, Barnes & Noble, Target, Urban Outfitters, and indie retailers.

Stay tuned for more details about the music of Grand Theft Auto VI, including the dynamic score, the next evolution of in-game radio, and more.

# Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album Now Available
### Listen Now on All Major Music Streaming Services, Also on Vinyl and CD at Select Retailers
November 20, 2026 [**Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album**](https://gtavi-thealbum.lnk.to/gtavithealbum), the official soundtrack album created in partnership with Atlantic Records, is available everywhere now. Stream it on all major music streaming services and get it on limited-edition vinyl and CD at [**gtavi-thealbum.com**](https://www.gtavi-thealbum.com/) and select retailers.

With 34 original songs, including brand-new tracks from Playboi Carti, Lana Del Rey, Don Toliver, Dua Lipa, JENNIE, JHAYCO, Zara Larsson, Gunna, Burna Boy, and more — Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album captures the electric energy of Vice City and Leonida.

To celebrate the launch, select artists from the soundtrack will also take the stage this weekend at [**Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival**](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/gtavi-thefestival) on Saturday, November 21 at Mana Wynwood in Miami.

For the full tracklist and much more, including details on the Original Score composed by Justice coming December 11, visit the [**Music**](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/music) section of the official GTAVI site.
